name: SebasTNHook
description: The books of a pool's liquidity providers. Each time a position collects LP fees through the PositionManager named at deployment, the hook adds them to a running total for the position's holder, per pool and per currency, and emits an event. It has no swap callback: to a swap this is a pool without a hook. It holds nothing, pays nothing, changes no fee and never stops a liquidity change.

reasons: No swap callback at all, no dynamic fee and no returns-delta flag.
The 0x91 address-prefix rule applies to a deployed address. This hook is not deployed.

pool.binding: None. Any pool may name this hook; each PoolId has its own totals.
pool.fee: Any. The hook does not read or set the fee.

math.expression: total += the fees the PoolManager reports as accrued to the position in this call

deltas.settledBy: Nobody. Without a returns-delta bit the PoolManager does not read the value.

externalCalls.why: Names the holder the fees are counted for. In try/catch: if it reverts, nothing is counted and the liquidity change goes through.

securityAssumptions: Assumes the v4 `PoolManager` is the only caller of the callbacks (enforced by the `onlyPoolManager` modifier inherited from `BaseHook`).
Assumes the PositionManager named at deployment is the official one: it sets a position's salt to its token id and its `ownerOf` names the holder.
doesNotGuarantee: Does not count fees of a position that is not held through the PositionManager named at deployment.
Does not say the totals are income: it counts LP fees collected, not gains or losses on the position.
Does not follow a position's NFT backwards: fees collected after a transfer count for the new holder.
Does not hold, move or owe anything.

invariants.statement: The hook's address carries exactly the permissions it declares: afterAddLiquidity and afterRemoveLiquidity, mask 0x500.
The constructor rejects an address with one bit different.
Fees a position collects are added to its holder's total, to the unit.
The total runs, and each holder has their own.
A position not held through the PositionManager is left alone and not counted.
Over any swaps and collections, the books equal what the holder received.
